verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a built-in simulated card reader for its Terminal SDKs and its server-driven integration. Developers can build and test without physical hardware, and Stripe explicitly recommends testing with the reader simulator before ordering a reader. Account sandboxes add a separate test environment that does not affect the live integration. missing for 10: documentation of simulated test card numbers and decline/error scenarios for in-person flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end simulator testing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live

citations.quote: Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Before ordering a reader, test your integration with the reader simulator.
You can use your sandbox to test Stripe functionality in your account, and experiment with new features without affecting your live integration.
